```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  copilot-setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bundle install

      - name: Run RSpec tests
        run: bundle exec rspec

      - name: Run ChefSpec tests
        run: bundle exec rspec spec/unit

      - name: Run Kitchen tests
        run: bundle exec kitchen test

      - name: Setup Copilot Custom Instructions
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          mkdir -p .github/copilot
          cat > .github/copilot/instructions.md << 'EOF'
          # Copilot Custom Instructions for sous-chefs/haproxy

          ## Platform Detection Logic
          - For RHEL >= 10, use PCRE2 support
          - For RHEL < 10, use standard PCRE
          - CentOS Stream 10 should use PCRE2

          ## Package Selection
          - Detect platform version to determine correct PCRE package
          - Ensure compatibility with HAProxy requirements

          ## Testing
          - Always run RSpec tests before committing
          - Verify Kitchen tests pass for all platforms
          - Check ChefSpec unit tests for cookbook resources

          ## Documentation
          - Update README.md when adding new features
          - Document platform-specific configurations
          - Include version requirements in documentation
          EOF

      - name: Commit Copilot instructions
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .github/copilot/instructions.md
          git commit -m "docs: Add Copilot custom instructions for platform detection" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push
```
